method: Original full image and five unlabeled detailed original-pixel crops were inspected before reading the previous per-row findings and effective label coordinates. Subsequently reviewed larger nearest-neighbor ruler crops. Fixed-size/no-slide/no-tilt/equal-rack constraints are user-supplied and help correspondence, not new observed hidden-point truth. No model inference or cross-frame coordinate transfer. Root review is required before any acceptance.
scope: 21 original rows and all explicit legacy unresolved fields for this case; not a certification of every other row/point.
manual_ranges_mean: Approximate judgement ranges on original pixels, not confidence intervals or measured ground-truth accuracy.
unchanged_endpoints: All effective parent point tokens preserved in every proposal; no hidden point restored.
